facts: A pair of threshold objects (entry docking pylons) stands 1.0-3.0 m inside the door, with a hanging screen (holographic entrance curtain) between them; the route slips through a 1.9 m gap.
The hero (floating eyewear centerpiece) stands alone in an empty 8 x 7 m area (orbital vacuum void); the route circles it and never comes closer than 3.3 m.
Four product stations (product docking stations) sit at the outer corners, outside the loop, so you turn away from the hero to reach them.
The pay desk (docking pay terminal) closes the loop at the back wall.

args.title: Hangar Zero
args.subtitle: An immersive docking experience in zero gravity.
args.line: A weightless descent into the quiet expanse of an orbital hangar.
args.synopsis: You step through a shimmering veil of steel cables, entering the hollow silence of a deep-space station. Your path pulls you into a wide, polished orbit around a singular display, where the eyewear appears to hover in defiance of physics. As you circulate the central void, you are drawn to the perimeter stations to engage with the objects before concluding your voyage at the docking terminal.
args.quote: Suspension in the vacuum is the ultimate luxury.

why.d: These massive concrete pillars and the shivering cable screen force you to pause, framing your transition from the world outside into the hangar's pressurized environment.
The vast, polished floor creates a sense of profound scale, emphasizing the isolation of the central display where the product drifts in weightless, cinematic suspension.
These stations act as auxiliary docking points, encouraging you to step out of the main orbital path to investigate the collection more closely.
The sleek steel desk marks the final point of your journey, grounding the experience as you finalize your exchange within the silent hangar.
